title: Baguetts+swords
description: this project adds abunch of baguetts and bagguet swords
body:
this mod adds baguette's baguette swords and ashes

**this mod is for 1.21.8 if you play on 1.21.9 or later it will crash or be VERY UNSTABLE**

**Also this mod requires [Fabric api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) to work**

**baguettes:**

**1**: baguette literally just a baguette crafted with 3 bread in a diagonal line heals 3 times more hunger and saturation than bread when eaten

**2**: well done baguette made by cooking a baguette Heals a little less hunger and saturation when eaten

**3**: overcooked baguette made by cooking well done baguette heals a little les hunger and saturation when eaten

**4**: Burned baguette made by cooking an overcooked baguette heals barely any hunger and saturation and gives hunger effect when eaten



**baguette swords:**

**baguette sword**: does decent damage (5.5) 0.5 less then iron sword. has 1001 durability also edible heals same amount of hunger and saturation as baguette and leaves stick behind after eaten

**well done baguette sword**: does less damage then the baguette sword (4.7) between wood and stone swords. has 751 durability also edible heals same amount of hunger and saturation as well done baguette and leaves behind a stick after eaten

**Overcooked baguette sword**: does'nt do much damage (3.9) less then wooden sword. has 600 durability also edible heals same amount as overcooked baguette and leaves behind a stick after eaten

**Burned baguette sword** Does barely any damage (2) has 400 durability also edible heals same amount of huner and saturation but doesn't give hunger effect and leaves a stick behind after eaten

**ashes**

ash (item) made by burning burned baguette sword/burned baguette 

shes (block) can be crfted by 4 ash in a square shape in the crafting grid can be placed like a slab


**advancements**

**baguette**: eat a baguette
